title: AdapterToStateMachineV0
description: Frozen mapping layer between CandidateConsequenceV0 and the EXISTING frozen DriveClarify offline reducer (driveclarify_offline). The reducer's real inputs are consequence.v0.1-shaped records + DivergenceResult/hard_feasibility. This schema is the ABSTRACT summary the adapter emits; each field states how it lands in the reducer. Three-valued (TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN). UNKNOWN never becomes FALSE and never bypasses a hard gate. The mapper adds ONLY adapter-side reason codes; it does not modify state-machine expected labels or transitions.

consequence_equivalence.description: Overall per-dimension equivalence; UNKNOWN in v0 (physical dims UNKNOWN).

material_task_divergence.description: Maps to DivergenceResult.D_G. UNKNOWN in v0.

material_safety_divergence.description: Maps to DivergenceResult.D_S. UNKNOWN in v0.

hard_safety_violation.description: Maps to hard_feasibility via safety.safety_class. UNKNOWN in v0 -> UNKNOWN_HARD_SAFETY.

hard_rule_violation.description: Maps to hard_feasibility via rule.severe_rule_conflict. UNKNOWN in v0 -> UNKNOWN_HARD_RULE.

time_to_decision_status.description: Reuses AskTimingStatus. UNKNOWN in v0 (needs F5 metric).

query_value_status.description: Whether clarification would materially change the decision; UNKNOWN in v0.

holding_plan_status.description: Whether a verified holding plan exists; UNKNOWN in v0 (no holding controller).

data_quality_status.description: Aggregate of input query statuses / staleness.

adapter_reason_codes.description: Adapter-side reasons ONLY (may reference existing reducer reason codes it will trigger, e.g. UNKNOWN_HARD_SAFETY, UNKNOWN_HARD_RULE, NO_HARD_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATE). Never invents a state or transition.

maps_to_reducer_inputs.description: Explicit projection into the EXISTING reducer input (driveclarify.consequence.v0.1 fields). In v0 all physical fields are UNKNOWN-preserving so the reducer's own hard-feasibility gate produces the reason-coded fallback.
